<h2>CDT Weekly Newsletter</h2><br><ul><li><p>Protect and Exploit Your Research Results</p></li><li><p>Transforming Business and Investment into a Force for Good</p></li><li><p>Bristol Doctoral College (BDC) Events and Opportunities</p></li><li><p>Recharge Festival</p></li><li><p>AI CDT Lunch and Learn Seminar</p></li><li><p>Reminder: End of Year Review Meeting &ndash; Please Complete the Short Form&nbsp;</p></li><li><p>Call for Researchers: FUTURES Schools Research Fair</p></li></ul><p><p>Welcome to this week's issue of the newsletter.</p></p><br><br><b><p>Protect and Exploit Your Research Results</p></b><br><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><strong>Tuesday 8 December 2026, 1 - 2pm,&nbsp;</strong><a href="https://teams.microsoft.com/meet/3269947825082480?p=nDO7WBXMYKeITldBD9"><strong>Online (Microsoft Teams)</strong></a></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">Join Abraham Mauleon Amieva, Research Commercialisation Manager at Bristol Innovations, for a session on protecting software intellectual property. He will explore different ways to protect software, including automatic legal rights, registered protections and confidentiality agreements.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The session will also introduce the Research Commercialisation team and explain how to engage with them, followed by a Q&amp;A.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">If you have topics you would like to see covered in a future How-To Session, or would like to contribute, please email <a href="mailto:cs-staff-enquiries@bristol.ac.uk">cs-staff-enquiries@bristol.ac.uk</a>.</p><br><br><b><p>Transforming Business and Investment into a Force for Good</p></b><br><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><strong>27 January 2027,</strong><span style="font-family: 'inter',serif; color: #333333; background: #F8F8F8;"> </span><strong>6:30 - 7:45pm, Bill Brown Forum, Sloane Robinson Building</strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">Join Erinch Sahan for a public talk hosted by Professor Martin Parker of the University of Bristol Business School, exploring how business and investment can be transformed into a force for good.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The talk is open to University staff, students, alumni and members of the public. Friends, family and colleagues are also welcome.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><a href="https://onlineshop.bristol.ac.uk/C20992_ustores/web/store_cat.jsp?STOREID=18&amp;CATID=51">Sign up via the University Online Shop</a>.</p><br><br><b><p>Bristol Doctoral College (BDC) Events and Opportunities</p></b><br><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline;"><strong><span style="mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Segoe UI'; color: black; mso-color-alt: windowtext; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">1. </span><span style="color: black; mso-color-alt: windowtext;">Finishing Your Research Degree</span></strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; tab-stops: 14.2pt; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 14.2pt;"><strong>12 November 2026, 2:00&ndash;4:00pm, <span style="mso-spacerun: yes;">&nbsp;</span>Senate House (PGR Hub) / Online</strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; tab-stops: 14.2pt; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 14.2pt;">Are you approaching the final stages of your research degree? Join the Bristol Doctoral College for this workshop to help you prepare for the milestones ahead and plan for a successful finish.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; tab-stops: 14.2pt; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 14.2pt;">The session will cover strategies for staying motivated, overcoming writing barriers and completing your thesis, as well as the submission process and what to expect at your viva. It will also help you consider how to translate the skills and experience gained during your research into future career opportunities, while connecting with PGRs from across the University.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; tab-stops: 14.2pt; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 14.2pt;"><a href="https://www.bristol.ac.uk/doctoral-college/events/#event=78450769;instance=20261112140000?popup=1&amp;lang=en-UK">Book your tickets here for face to face session.</a></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; tab-stops: 14.2pt; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 14.2pt;"><a href="https://www.bristol.ac.uk/doctoral-college/events/#event=78450770;instance=20261112140000?popup=1&amp;lang=en-UK">Book your tickets here for online session.</a></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><strong>2. Beyond the Thesis: Deciding What&rsquo;s Next</strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 14.2pt;"><strong>17 November 2026, 10:30&ndash;11:30am, Online via Teams</strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 14.2pt;">Unsure about your next career step after your PhD? Join the Bristol Doctoral College for an introductory session on career decision-making, particularly suited to full-time PhD students in their second or third year.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 14.2pt;">The session will explore how career decisions are made, help you develop criteria for evaluating different career options, and highlight sources of support and useful resources. It will also look at UK and Bristol PGR graduate destinations data, including where and with whom doctoral graduates find employment.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 14.2pt;"><a href="https://www.bristol.ac.uk/doctoral-college/events/#event=78466387;instance=20261117103000?popup=1&amp;lang=en-UK">Book your tickets here.</a></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><strong>3. Responding Effectively to Feedback on Your Writing</strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 14.2pt;"><strong>24 November 2026, 10:00am&ndash;12:00nn, Senate House (PGR Hub)</strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 14.2pt;">Getting feedback on your writing is an important part of developing as a researcher. Join the Centre for Academic Language and Development (CALD) for this interactive workshop, open to PGRs at any stage of their research degree.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 14.2pt;">Using examples of feedback you have received, the session will help you interpret comments, decide which suggestions to take forward and revise your writing effectively.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 14.2pt;"><em>Please bring examples of feedback you have received on your writing to use during the session. Refreshments will be provided during a short break.</em></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 14.2pt;"><a href="https://www.bristol.ac.uk/doctoral-college/events/#event=78450456;instance=20261124100000?popup=1&amp;lang=en-UK">Book your tickets here.</a></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><strong>4. Mature PGR Student Meet-up</strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 14.2pt;"><strong>25 November 2026, 2:30&ndash;3:30pm, Senate House (PGR Hub)</strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 14.2pt;">Are you a mature postgraduate researcher looking to connect with others on a similar journey? Join the first meet-up of the academic year organised by the Mature PGR Student Network. It&rsquo;s an opportunity to meet fellow mature PGRs, share experiences and discuss the challenges of being a mature student. Tea, coffee and pastries will be provided.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 14.2pt;"><a href="https://www.bristol.ac.uk/doctoral-college/events/#event=78505223;instance=20261125143000?popup=1&amp;lang=en-UK">Book your tickets here.</a></p><br><br><b><p>Recharge Festival</p></b><br><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><strong>Tuesday 10 November , 11am&ndash;3pm, Senate House</strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">Take a break and boost your wellbeing at the Recharge Festival, a free one-day event offering more than 30 activities, resources and advice to help you recharge as the end of term approaches.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">Drop in at any time to explore the games, crafts, cooking, mindfulness, massage, and more&hellip;!</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><a href="https://events.timely.fun/gxho5xsp/event/78439102/20261110110000">Book your tickets here.</a><br>Find out more at the <a href="https://uob.sharepoint.com/teams/grp-rechargefestival" target="_blank" rel="noopener">event SharePoint page.</a></p><br><br><b><p>AI CDT Lunch and Learn Seminar</p></b><br><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline;"><span style="mso-ascii-font-family: Aptos; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: Aptos; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; color: black; mso-color-alt: windowtext; border: none windowtext 1.0pt; mso-border-alt: none windowtext 0cm; padding: 0cm; background: white; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">Please save the date for our next CDT AI Lunch and Learn Seminar as follows:</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline;"><strong><span style="mso-ascii-font-family: Aptos; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: Aptos; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; color: black; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">Location: </span></strong><span style="mso-ascii-font-family: Aptos; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: Aptos; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; color: black; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">Room 3.305, Sloane Robinson Building</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline;"><strong><span style="mso-ascii-font-family: Aptos; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: Aptos; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; color: black; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">Time</span></strong><span style="mso-ascii-font-family: Aptos; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: Aptos; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; color: black; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">: 1:30 - 3pm</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline;"><strong><span style="mso-ascii-font-family: Aptos; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: Aptos; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; color: black; border: none windowtext 1.0pt; mso-border-alt: none windowtext 0cm; padding: 0cm; background: white; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">Speaker: </span></strong><span style="mso-ascii-font-family: Aptos; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: Aptos; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; color: black; border: none windowtext 1.0pt; mso-border-alt: none windowtext 0cm; padding: 0cm; background: white; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;"><a href="https://www.bristol.ac.uk/people/person/Henry%20Mark-Glyde-2a81a8f2-dad2-40c3-9a3a-c9bfafa42070/">Dr Henry Mark Glyde</a> (<a href="https://www.bristol.ac.uk/medical-school/">Bristol Medical School</a>)</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline;"><strong><span style="mso-ascii-font-family: Aptos; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: Aptos; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; color: black; border: none windowtext 1.0pt; mso-border-alt: none windowtext 0cm; padding: 0cm; background: white; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">Talk title:</span></strong><span style="mso-ascii-font-family: Aptos; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: Aptos; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; color: black; border: none windowtext 1.0pt; mso-border-alt: none windowtext 0cm; padding: 0cm; background: white; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;"> to be confirmed.</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline;"><em><span style="mso-ascii-font-family: Aptos; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: Aptos; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; color: black; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">We will have a light lunch and the chance to network with colleagues in the social area, <strong>room 3.710 from 1:30 - 2pm</strong> followed by the talk in <strong>room 3.305 from 2pm - 3pm</strong>. Please join us if you can.</span></em></p><br><br><b><p>Reminder: End of Year Review Meeting &ndash; Please Complete the Short Form&nbsp;</p></b><br><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span style="mso-ascii-font-family: Aptos; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: Aptos; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; color: black; border: none windowtext 1.0pt; mso-border-alt: none windowtext 0cm; padding: 0cm; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">We&rsquo;re now just a month away from the CDT </span>End of Year Review Meeting which will take place at <a title="https://www.bristol.ac.uk/venues/meetings/goldney-house/" href="https://www.bristol.ac.uk/venues/meetings/goldney-house/">Goldney House</a> on <strong>Wednesday 16 December from 9:30am - 2:30pm</strong>.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The agenda for the day will include a feedback meeting with the opportunity to feed into the Mid-term review.&nbsp; We will also have a tour of the <a title="https://www.atlasobscura.com/places/goldney-grotto" href="https://www.atlasobscura.com/places/goldney-grotto">grotto</a><a title="https://www.atlasobscura.com/places/goldney-grotto" href="https://www.atlasobscura.com/places/goldney-grotto"> </a>at Goldney followed by lunch and plenty of opportunity to catch up with colleagues.<span style="mso-ascii-font-family: Aptos; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: Aptos; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; color: black; border: none windowtext 1.0pt; mso-border-alt: none windowtext 0cm; padding: 0cm; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;"><br><strong>To help prepare for the workshop, please complete </strong></span><strong><span style="mso-ascii-font-family: Aptos; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: Aptos; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; border: none windowtext 1.0pt; mso-border-alt: none windowtext 0cm; padding: 0cm; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;"><a href="https://forms.cloud.microsoft/e/UZ0SKAmwPG">the short form</a> </span>and indicate your availability by Monday 30 November 2026.</strong></p><br><br><b><p>Call for Researchers: FUTURES Schools Research Fair</p></b><br><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><strong>Application deadline: 5pm, Monday 16 November</strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">Researchers are invited to take part in the FUTURES Schools Research Fair, an annual event giving hundreds of children from local primary schools the opportunity to meet researchers and explore hands-on activities and demonstrations.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The FUTURES team is looking for interactive stalls that will engage and inspire young visitors. Your idea does not need to be fully developed, as the team will work with you to refine it.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><a href="https://us.list-manage.com/SIAPbsYQk0d?e=27202c3f57&amp;c2id=12f9904aaaaafb5e77b20191e2a1235e">Find out more and apply</a>.</p><br><br><h2>Forthcoming Calendar of Events</h2><br><br><b><p><span style="font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 115%; font-family: 'Aptos',sans-serif; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; color: black; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB; mso-bidi-language: AR-SA;">UK AI Research Symposium </span></p> - 2026-11-24</b><br>
